purpose: pytest coverage for threaded server configuration and TelnetRequestHandler socket-write error handling without opening real network sockets.
invariants: ThreadedTCPServer must use daemon threads and reusable addresses.
Broken pipe and connection reset stop the player instead of propagating.
Unexpected socket write errors still raise to the caller.
gotchas: Tests construct TelnetRequestHandler with object.__new__ to avoid requiring a real socketserver request lifecycle.
